name: aqg-evidence-closeout
description: Produce an evidence-backed closeout for project work, covering fresh verification, audit adjudication, durable state, untouched boundaries, worktree state, and remaining blockers. Use before claiming completion, posting a final answer, or PR/issue handoff; not to run checks, perform audits, or authorize production actions.

sentence_patterns: Close out this task with evidence
Generate the closeout ledger before I claim done
走 closeout 流程, 把 evidence 落清楚
Before I open the PR, run evidence closeout

cli_contract.0: success — closeout skeleton printed; ledger imported if present
cli_contract.1: reserved — closeout surfaces missing evidence in output, does not raise
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse propagates exit 2 on bad args

owner_only_actions: Production / deploy / restart / secrets / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization; closeout never claims them done

cases.prompt: I'm about to say the task is done — first walk through the evidence ledger
Before I open the PR, generate the closeout skeleton with current evidence
Finished editing the status doc — before handing off to the owner I need an evidence-backed closeout
Tests pass — write the evidence ledger summarizing what changed and what's blocked
Please use /aqg-evidence-closeout to produce this round's evidence
